description: Call this after before_checkout says reaches_checkout is false or null, or when an agent got stuck at a store and you want the reason and the fix. Returns why (the saved blockers), fix (the store page's recorded fix, or "not recorded"), next_step and links to the full record. Example: why_blocked_and_fix({"store":"gymshark.com"}) → {"why":["…"],"fix":"…","next_step":"…"}. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as gymshark.com.
